questions.question: Which hours apply on public holidays?

options.title: The same hours
options.explanation: The reply lists one set of hours for every day. Recommended, because a comment on the ticket states that the hours are the same on weekends.

options.title: Closed on public holidays
options.explanation: The reply lists public holidays as closed.

answer.note: Public holidays follow the weekday hours, except 25 December, when support is closed.

questions.question: Should the reply list the hours, or link to the help page that lists them?

options.title: List the hours
options.explanation: A customer reads the hours in the reply.

options.title: Link to the help page
options.explanation: The reply stays correct when the hours change again.

questions.question: From which date does the reply list the new hours?
questions.context: Since 2026-10-01, support answers from 8:00 to 20:00, according to the ticket. The earlier answer is 2026-11-01, a month after the hours changed.

questions.question: Should customers who got the reply with the old hours receive a corrected reply?

options.title: Send a corrected reply
options.explanation: Customers who got the old hours learn the new hours. Recommended, because those customers otherwise keep hours that ended on 2026-10-01.

options.title: Send nothing more
options.explanation: Only new replies list the new hours.

questions.question: Should the reply list 25 December as closed?
questions.context: The answer about public holidays: they follow the weekday hours, except 25 December, when support is closed.

options.title: List it
options.explanation: The reply lists 8:00 to 20:00 every day, and 25 December as closed. Recommended, because the answer about public holidays states that support is closed on 25 December.

options.title: Leave it out
options.explanation: The reply lists 8:00 to 20:00 every day, with no exception.

questions.question: Where are the support hours kept?

options.title: In the reply's text
options.explanation: Only this reply changes. The next change of hours edits the reply again.

options.title: In one shared setting
options.explanation: Every saved reply would need a change to read the setting.

decision.reason: In a note of 2026-10-18, Sam Example asked to keep the hours in the reply's text, and a shared setting can still replace the text later.
